strings.mdKbNet: • Network kaw na Keybox: official repository (GitHub) kaw na keybox langai hpe download galaw nna /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. de bang da ai Internet ra ai hte minit 1-3 ram aten la ra ai. Smart fetch n mai galaw ai shaloi (sh) keybox hpe lata hte galai kau ai shaloi lang ai.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP ana jep chyoi ai lam: nga ai Remote Key Provisioning module ni hpe jep yu nna, TEE sakse hkam ai lam hpe jep yu nna, KmInstallKeybox arung arai a masa hpe madun dan ai. Hpa mung n galai shai ai — asan sha nga ai device status hpe yu ai.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine hpe jep yu ai (hti na matu sha): dumpsys kaw na Widevine madang masat kumla ni (L1/L3) hpe madun dan ai, DRM (IDM) key-file nga ai, hte seng ai system a arawn alai ni hpe madun dan ai. Hpa hpe mung n galai shai ai.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Laika buk RKP gram lajang ai: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh laika buk hpe galaw ai. Automatic pass n lu ai shaloi, sakse hkam ai lam hpe gram lajang ya ai. Run shagu hta awng dang/ hkrat sum ai lam hpe asan sha ka da ai.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Hkum tsup ai RKP hpe gram lajang ai: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh hpe tup hkrak galaw ai. Hard case ni hpe hparan ya nna aten grau na hkra la ra ai. Hpang jahtum hta asan sha mahtai pru wa ai.
strings.mdGmsReset: • GMS hpe bai gram lajang na: Play Store hte Google services (GMS+GSF) ni hpe yeng seng kau ya nna, device hpe shi hkrai shi bai hpaw ya ai. Stubborn attestation a matu sha — na a sumla ni (sh) file ni hpe galoi mung n hkra ai.
strings.mdCertify: • Play certification: device a RKP masat masa galaw ai masa hpe jep yu nna, ra ai rai yang masat masa galaw ai atsam ni hpe bai gram lajang ya ai. User data hpe n hkra ai.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER gram lajang ai: jak rung hpe sakse hkam ai lam hte seng ai Google magam bungli masa (SOTER) manghkang ni hpe gram lajang ya ai. Play Integrity a malai SOTER hpe kam hpa ai jak nkau mi a matu lang ai.
strings.mdPifApply: • PIF hpe jai lang u: sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh n-gun hpe galaw ai. Lata da ai lata masat (local/advanced) hpe lang nna pif.prop/pif.json file ni hpe gram lajang ai. Log kaw asan sha mahtai pru wa ai.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: gaw, n-gun rawng ai engine a masa, lata masat file ni (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), hte log ni hpe madun dan ai. Check sha galaw ai — hpa hpe mung n galai shai ai.
